metadata.description: Skills and agents for Claude Code and Codex that take a change from discussion to merge: a plan file, phases built by subagents, a review and an e2e check, then human approval.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Eight stages for every change: a grill or a discussion, an optional prototype, a plan file, phases built by implementer subagents, a review and an e2e check, a human approval of the product, land and a code review, and finish. The session the user started coordinates and does not edit code. Skills and agents only, no hooks or scripts.
